questions.q: Why does raw data need to be loaded into Snowflake before dbt ever gets involved?
options: dbt transforms data already in the warehouse; it doesn't load data into the warehouse
dbt can only read data from local CSV files, never from Snowflake tables
Snowflake requires dbt to be installed before any table can be created
Loading and transforming must happen in the same SQL statement
questions.explain: Loading and transforming are two separate jobs: a stage + COPY INTO loads raw files into the warehouse first, and only then can dbt transform what's already there.

questions.q: What does the CREATE OR REPLACE STAGE statement in this lesson actually do?
options: Installs dbt inside the Snowflake account
Creates the final customers table dbt will build
Creates a named Snowflake pointer to the public S3 location holding the real Jaffle Shop seed files
Permanently copies all S3 data into Snowflake's storage
questions.explain: A stage is just a pointer to a storage location — here, the public S3 bucket hosting dbt Labs' real Jaffle Shop CSV files — not a copy of the data itself.

questions.q: After running COPY INTO, which two columns in the result set should be compared to confirm the load actually worked?
options: rows_parsed and rows_loaded
file_format and stage_name
database_name and schema_name
first_name and last_name
questions.explain: If rows_parsed and rows_loaded don't match, ON_ERROR = 'CONTINUE' silently skipped some rows, and first_error should be checked before assuming the load is fine.

questions.q: Which three columns does the real raw_customers seed table used in this lesson actually have?
options: id, first_name, last_name
id, full_name, region
customer_id, email, signup_date
customer_id, first_name, last_name, order_count
questions.explain: The real public Jaffle Shop raw_customers seed file has exactly three columns: id, first_name, and last_name.

questions.q: What will raw_customers become once Lesson 5 is reached?
options: A dbt mart model
A dbt source — a declared pointer to exactly this table
A deleted table, replaced by a dbt-generated one
A Power BI dataset
questions.explain: Lesson 5 declares raw_customers as a dbt source, which only works because this lesson already loaded the real table it points at.
